items.title: Harness, Omnigent meta-harness and the future of AI
items.author: codebasics
items.summary:
In this podcast, we are having a conversation with Elise Gonzales who is  the staff product manager at Databricks. We will discuss what is harness, meta-harness, Omnigent opensource package for meta-harness.

Elise's linkedin: https://www.linkedin.com/in/elise-gonzales-3b4a7069/
